title: Why Reliable Agents Start with Action Boundaries
description:
Agents fail less often when action is treated as a contract surface, not a vibe layered on top of language.

This cinematic brief focuses on the boundary between language and action: what changes once a model can make commitments, touch tools, and leave traces in the world.

It should pull in builders who need a sharper mental model for tool use than generic agent demos provide.
